environment.initial_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: a clean simple scientific system-environment illustration, landscape 16:9, high-resolution PNG, Chinese labels.
Draw a minimal flat vector-style schematic on a pure white background of the CURRENT formal multi-UAV buoy data-collection simulator. Exact counts are essential: EXACTLY SIX quadcopter UAV icons and EXACTLY TWELVE buoy icons, no extra drone or buoy icons anywhere, including the legend. Do not draw a sea, waves, coastline, mountains, trees, satellites, base stations, humans or buildings.
Title centered at top, exact text: "当前系统环境示意". Subtitle, exact text: "6 架无人机 · 12 个浮标".
Layout: a light thin rounded rectangular boundary represents a 160 m × 80 m operating region. Inside it, place six clearly separated teal quadcopter icons in a higher horizontal band, labeled once each U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U6 from left to right. Beneath them, place twelve simple orange buoy icons: two groups of six, the left group labeled B1 through B6, right group B7 through B12. Each group of six buoys arranged in two rows of three, with ample spacing. Small gray group labels "浮标簇 1" and "浮标簇 2". Count every buoy precisely.
Use a few thin dashed teal association lines, one line from each UAV to one distinct buoy, no repeated destination: U1→B1, U2→B3, U3→B5, U4→B7, U5→B9, U6→B11. Lines mean assigned target, not guaranteed service. Keep lines behind icons and labels.
A compact bottom note, exact text: "目标关联仅为示意；允许无人机空闲，目标浮标不重复". A second bottom note, exact text: "48 步 / 回合 · 每 15 步更新任务 · 服务半径 16 m".
Use crisp simple icon outlines, dark navy typography, restrained teal and orange accents, large readable Chinese sans-serif text. No 3D, photorealism, decorative scenery, watermark, or visual clutter. This is a schematic, not an exact position trace. Prioritize exact counts, label accuracy, legibility, and clean alignment.
environment.final_edit: Edit the attached system-environment diagram only. Keep the exact existing SIX UAV icons U1-U6 and TWELVE buoy icons B1-B12, their layout, labels, title, subtitle, boundary, scale, cluster labels, font style, colors, and bottom parameter line unchanged. Remove ALL dashed teal association lines completely, so no UAV-to-buoy lines or buoy-to-buoy lines remain. Do not add any new icons. Replace the first bottom explanatory sentence with the exact text: “无人机采集浮标队列中的数据（位置仅为示意）”. Keep the second bottom line “48 步 / 回合 · 每 15 步更新任务 · 服务半径 16 m”. This must be a clean count-and-distribution schematic, with no association ambiguity and no scenery. Everything else should remain visually identical.

dataflow.final_prompt:
Create a NEW clean Chinese scientific data-flow flowchart for the current formal multi-UAV system. White background, flat vector-style, teal and navy accents, landscape 16:9, sharp readable labels.
Title: "当前系统数据流". Subtitle: "高层每 15 步决策 · 低层每步执行 · 模型冻结".
Use EXACTLY EIGHT rounded rectangular process boxes, arranged as a simple serpentine loop: FOUR boxes in the TOP row going LEFT TO RIGHT, then FOUR boxes in the BOTTOM row going RIGHT TO LEFT. Connect only immediate neighbors with ONE clearly directed arrow, and one outer loop from the final bottom-left box back up to the initial top-left box. NO extra arrows, NO branches, NO disconnected line segments, NO intermediate floating boxes.
TOP row, left to right:
1. "环境当前状态" with subtext "位置 · 队列 · 链路"
2. "候选与图特征" with subtext "G1_RATE top-6 · 异构图"
3. "高层 HGNN 评分" with subtext "Scheme C · 稳定排序"
4. "TaskOption" with subtext "联合任务关联 · hold = 15"
Single downward arrow from box 4 into box 5 directly below it.
BOTTOM row, right to left:
5. "低层观测与 Actor" with subtext "任务 + 实时状态 → MAPPO-V2"
6. "运动意图" with subtext "fly-toward + 二维残差"
7. "SafetyProjector" with subtext "动作裁剪 · 安全投影"
8. "环境 step 与记账" with subtext "served_bits · payload · 新队列"
The bottom horizontal arrows must all point LEFT: 5 → 6 → 7 → 8.
Draw ONE feedback arrow, from the left side of box 8 around the left outside margin upward and into the left side of box 1. Label its vertical section "状态更新" in a small readable horizontal label. This is the only feedback line. It must not touch any other box.
Top row group heading "高层任务规划", bottom row group heading "低层运动执行". Generous spacing, consistent box sizes, tidy typography. Do not add extra standalone feedback caption boxes. Footer exact text: "低层在 hold 内保持目标不变；实际成功服务的比特计入 payload。"
The diagram must clearly communicate the information flow without training arrows or speculative priority/tag modules. Top-6 is per UAV, not six total candidates. Preserve exact technical spellings and all labels. No mountains, oceans, decorative icons, gradients, watermarks or extraneous drawings.
